title: hieracium laevigatum subsp. lotharingum
intro: Hieracium laevigatum subsp. lotharingum, commonly known as the smooth hawk's beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family with medicinal properties. The smooth hawk's beard plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as promoting wound healing. The smooth hawk's beard plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
